title: WAS y WERE
subtitle: Was and were · el pasado de to be

map.center: WAS y WERE son el pasado de TO BE: era, estaba, fui, estuve… ¡Viajamos al ayer!

nodes.title: There was / were
items: There was a cat and there were two dogs.

items.q: There ___ two cats in the garden.

explain.es: Was y were son el pasado del verbo TO BE. Si am / is / are significan soy, estoy, entonces was / were significan era, estaba, fui, estuve. Los usamos para hablar de cómo eran las cosas, dónde estábamos y cómo nos sentíamos en el pasado: ayer, el verano pasado, cuando éramos pequeños…
explain.en: Was and were are the past of the verb TO BE. We use them to say where we were, what things were like and how we felt in the past.

explain.title: Del presente al pasado
head: Presente · Present
Pasado · Past
Español
explain.note: ¡Buena noticia! En presente hay tres formas (am, is, are), pero en pasado solo hay dos: was y were.
explain.note_en: Good news: only two forms in the past, was and were.

explain.title: 1 · Afirmativa
explain.es: Con I, he, she, it (y con un solo nombre: Mario, my dog, the film) usamos was. Con you, we, they (y con plurales: my friends, the dogs) usamos were. ¡Ojo! You siempre va con were, aunque hables con una sola persona.
explain.en: Use was with I, he, she, it. Use were with you, we, they. You always takes were, even for one person.
formula: I / he / she / it + *was* + at home

examples.es: El verano pasado estuvimos en Asturias.

explain.title: 2 · Negativa
explain.es: Para negar, ponemos not detrás de was / were: was not (wasn't) y were not (weren't). ¡Igual que con am / is / are! No usamos didn't ni no.
explain.en: Add not after was / were: wasn't, weren't. Never use didn't or no.

examples.es: Mis amigos no estaban en la fiesta.

explain.title: 3 · Preguntas
explain.es: Para preguntar, was o were saltan delante del sujeto. ¡Es el Verbo Saltarín! No hace falta ningún ayudante: nada de did.
explain.en: To ask a question, put Was / Were before the subject. No did!

examples.en: Were Leo and Sara at the park?
examples.es: ¿Estaban Leo y Sara en el parque?

explain.title: 4 · Respuestas cortas
head: Pregunta · Question
Sí · Yes
No
explain.note: Ojo: Were you…? → Yes, I was. ¡Cambia el sujeto y el verbo!

explain.title: Todo junto
head: Sujeto · Subject
✅ Afirmativa
⛔ Negativa
❓ Pregunta
💬 Respuesta corta
rows: Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.
Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.
Yes, he was. / No, he wasn't.
Yes, she was. / No, she wasn't.
Yes, it was. / No, it wasn't.
Yes, we were. / No, we weren't.
Yes, they were. / No, they weren't.

explain.title: There was / There were
explain.es: There is / There are (hay) en pasado es There was / There were: había, hubo. There was + una cosa (singular). There were + varias cosas (plural). En español siempre decimos «había», pero en inglés mira si es uno o son varios.
explain.en: There was + singular, There were + plural (= había / hubo).
formula: *There were* + two / some / lots of + plural

examples.en: There was a big cake at the party.
examples.es: Había una tarta grande en la fiesta.

examples.en: There were lots of people at the beach.
examples.es: Había mucha gente en la playa.

examples.en: Was there a pool at the hotel? — Yes, there was.

explain.title: Nacer: I was born
explain.es: En inglés nacer se dice be born. Por eso «nací» es I was born (¡literalmente «fui nacido»!). Nunca digas I born ni I am born. Para el año o la ciudad usamos in.
explain.en: Nacer = be born. «Nací» = I was born. Never say I born.
formula: I / he / she + *was born* + in 2016 / in Madrid

examples.en: Where were you born? — I was born in Valencia.

explain.title: ¿Cómo estabas? ¿Cómo era?
explain.title_en: How were you? What was it like?

explain.title: ¡Trampa! Tener, hacer… → BE
explain.es: Muchas cosas que en español van con tener o hacer, en inglés van con TO BE: el hambre, el frío, el miedo, la edad y el tiempo. En pasado → was / were.
explain.en: Hunger, cold, fear, age and weather use be in English.

items.es: Lucía tenía ocho años en esta foto.

items.en: Leo and Tom were in my team.
items.es: Leo y Tom estaban en mi equipo.

items.en: It was rainy, so we were at home.
items.es: Llovía, así que estábamos en casa.

items.en: Our teacher wasn't at school on Monday.
items.es: Nuestra profe no estuvo en el cole el lunes.

items.en: There were ten candles on the cake.
items.es: Había diez velas en la tarta.

items.en: Was Rocky in the garden? — Yes, he was.
There wasn't any milk in the fridge.
items.es: No había leche en la nevera.

items.why: En la pregunta, were salta delante.
Se niega con not, no con «no».

items.es: Busca el sujeto: ¿quién era o dónde estaba?
¿Es I, he, she, it o una sola cosa? → was. ¿Es you, we, they o varias? → were.
items.en: I / he / she / it → was. You / we / they → were.

items.es: ¿Pregunta? Pon Was / Were delante del sujeto. ¡Sin did!

lines.en: Hi, Mario! Where were you on Saturday?
I was at my grandma's house in the village.
lines.es: Estuve en casa de mi abuela, en el pueblo.

lines.en: Yes, it was! There were lots of animals: two horses, a cow and three cats.
lines.es: ¡Sí! Había muchos animales: dos caballos, una vaca y tres gatos.

lines.en: Yes, he was. But he wasn't happy with the cats!
lines.es: Sí. ¡Pero no estaba contento con los gatos!

lines.en: Ha, ha! And were you tired on Sunday?
Very tired! I was in bed at eight o'clock.
lines.es: ¡Muy cansado! A las ocho ya estaba en la cama.

explain.title: Truco de las parejas
explain.es: am e is son primos: los dos se convierten en was. are va solo y se convierte en were (las dos acaban en -re). Y you siempre es were, aunque sea una sola persona: You were great, Mario!
explain.en: am, is → was · are → were (both end in -re). You → always were.

exercises.title: Lee y contesta
exercises.es: Lee el texto. Marca T (true, verdadero) o F (false, falso) y contesta las preguntas.
exercises.en: Read the text. Tick T or F and answer the questions.
text: Last Saturday, Mario and his family were at the zoo. It was a sunny day, but it wasn't very hot. Lucía was very excited because there were two baby lions!

The lions were asleep, so Mario was a bit sad. But the monkeys were really funny. There was a big gorilla too. He was very quiet. At one o'clock they were very hungry. There was a nice café next to the penguins, and the pizzas there were delicious!
Rocky wasn't at the zoo, because dogs aren't allowed. He was at Grandma's house.

items.why: The lions were asleep. The monkeys were funny.

items.a: No, he wasn't. He was very quiet.
It was next to the penguins.

items.q: Why was Mario a bit sad?

checklist.es: Sé que was / were son el pasado de am / is / are.
checklist.en: I know was / were are the past of be.

checklist.es: Uso was con I, he, she, it y were con you, we, they.
checklist.en: I use was and were correctly.

checklist.es: Hago negativas con wasn't / weren't (sin «no» ni did).
checklist.en: I can make negatives with wasn't / weren't.

checklist.es: Hago preguntas poniendo Was / Were delante: Were you…?
checklist.en: I can ask questions with Was / Were.

checklist.es: Contesto con respuestas cortas: Yes, I was. / No, they weren't.

checklist.en: I can use there was / there were.

checklist.es: Digo cuándo y dónde nací: I was born in…
checklist.en: I can say when and where I was born.
